name: Noelle
role: Main DPS & support: Geo shield healer
mistakes: Using her Burst without her shield up: at C1 having both active guarantees healing.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Favonius Bladework - Maid
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 claymore strikes, a spinning Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Breastplate
abilities.canon:
Summons protective stone armor, dealing Geo DMG to surrounding opponents and creating a shield. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Noelle's DEF.
The shield has the following properties:
·When Noelle's Normal and Charged Attacks hit a target, they have a certain chance to regenerate HP for all characters.
·Possesses 150% DMG Absorption efficiency against all Elemental and Physical DMG.

The amount of HP healed when regeneration is triggered scales based on Noelle's DEF.
abilities.simple: Geo damage and a shield based on her DEF; her attacks can heal the party while it’s up.

abilities.name: Sweeping Time
abilities.canon:
Gathering the strength of stone around her weapon, Noelle strikes the opponents surrounding her within a large AoE, dealing Geo DMG.
Afterwards, Noelle gains the following effects:
·Larger attack AoE.
·Converts attack DMG to Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.
·Increased ATK that scales based on her DEF.
abilities.simple: A big Geo strike, then larger, Geo-converted attacks with ATK raised based on her DEF.

abilities.name: Devotion
abilities.canon:
When Noelle is in the party but not on the field, this ability triggers automatically when your active character's HP falls below 30%:
Creates a shield for your active character that lasts for 20s and absorbs DMG equal to 400% of Noelle's DEF.
The shield has a 150% DMG Absorption effectiveness against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
This effect can only occur once every 60s.
abilities.simple: Off the field, when the active character’s HP drops low, she gives them a shield (once in a while).

abilities.name: Nice and Clean
abilities.canon:
Noelle will decrease the CD of Breastplate by 1s for every 4 Normal or Charged Attack hits she scores on opponents.
One hit may be counted every 0.1s.
abilities.simple: Every 4 Normal or Charged Attack hits cut her Skill cooldown by 1s.

abilities.name: Maid's Knighthood
abilities.canon: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a DEF-boosting dish, Noelle has a 12% chance to obtain double the product.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: I Got Your Back
abilities.canon: While Sweeping Time and Breastplate are both in effect, the chance of Breastplate's healing effects activating is increased to 100%.
abilities.simple: With her Burst and shield both active, the shield’s healing always triggers.

abilities.name: Combat Maid
abilities.canon: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Noelle's Charged Attacks by 20% and increases her Charged Attack DMG by 15%.
abilities.simple: Her Charged Attacks cost 20% less Stamina and deal 15% more damage.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Maid
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Breastplate by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Breastplate by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: To Be Cleaned
abilities.canon: When Breastplate's duration expires or it is destroyed by DMG, it will deal 400% of Noelle's ATK as Geo DMG to surrounding opponents.
abilities.simple: When her shield expires or breaks, it deals 400% of her ATK as Geo damage.

abilities.name: Favonius Sweeper Master
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Sweeping Time by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Sweeping Time by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Must Be Spotless
abilities.canon:
Sweeping Time increases Noelle's ATK by an additional 50% of her DEF.
Additionally, every opponent defeated during the skill's duration adds 1s to the duration, up to 10s.
abilities.simple: Her Burst adds ATK equal to 50% of her DEF, and defeating enemies extends it.

fundamentals.simple: Noelle’s shield can heal the party when she attacks; her Burst turns her attacks into Geo and scales them with DEF.
